page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-32-highlssd is a memory-optimized and storage-heavy server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor. This x86_64 architecture platform features 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations. It is equipped with 256 GB of system memory, providing 8 GB of RAM per vCPU, and features 12,884 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the average tier for general CPU compute, with a Passmark CPU score of 37,463.33 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 14,066.0. However, it demonstrates strong performance in specific workloads, particularly in image processing with a Geekbench score of 14,126.0 and small-model LLM inference, achieving 2,433.87 tokens per second for prompt processing on a 135M parameter model. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2,175.06 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write speeds reach 115.28 GB/sec and 49.39 GB/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the z3-highmem-32-highlssd offers a high-density resource profile by combining substantial memory capacity with massive local NVMe SSD storage. This makes it highly suitable for data-intensive operations without requiring external storage attachments. The instance is optimized for workloads such as large-scale database operations, Redis caching layers, in-memory data processing, and localized machine learning inference tasks that leverage its AMX instruction sets.
